note: task-1368: keyless `api.jup.ag` /swap/v1/quote exceeded on purpose (8 back-to-back GETs from one IP; read-only, no key, nothing signed or sent) to record what a Jupiter rate limit looks like. Requests 1-2 answered 200 with x-ratelimit-remaining 1 then 0; requests 3-8 answered 429. There is NO Retry-After header: the honest wait is x-ratelimit-reset (epoch seconds) minus now — here 3 s. The window observed is 5 requests per ~10 s per IP (x-ratelimit-current 5). The same shape is assumed for POST /swap/v1/swap, which the live ticket hit (`HTTP 429 for https://api.jup.ag/swap/v1/swap`); a /swap 429 was not provoked on purpose because the build needs a quote object and burns the same window.

liteApiSameMinute.note: The alternate keyless host answered the same quote with an nginx 503 (text/html, no rate-limit headers) at 21:46:24Z — a 5xx on the OTHER host must alternate straight back, which is why the retry policy treats 5xx like 429 for host rotation.
